Common questions

Quick answers before you call

How fast can you get to me?
Tap to reveal

Most calls in Indianapolis get a same-day technician. Emergency callouts — door stuck open or off track — are prioritized and usually arrive within a couple of hours.

Tap to flip back
Do you offer free estimates?
Tap to reveal

Yes. We give a free, no-obligation quote before any work starts, whether it's a quick spring adjustment or a full door replacement.

Tap to flip back
Is it safe to use my garage door if a spring is broken?
Tap to reveal

No — a broken spring puts extra strain on the opener and cables, which can lead to a sudden drop. Stop using the door and call us for a same-day repair.

Tap to flip back
What areas do you cover?
Tap to reveal

We currently serve the greater Indianapolis metro area, with more cities coming soon. Not sure if you're in range? Just give us a call.

Tap to flip back
Do you warranty your repairs?
Tap to reveal

Every repair and part we install is backed by a workmanship warranty, so you're covered if anything needs a follow-up visit.
